app.title: energyMatrix
app.subtitle: Building Energy Management
overview.title: Energy Overview
overview.desc: Total energy, subitem breakdown, data confidence and balance check — every figure comes from a backend function
overview.gapHint: Modelled as an emGap virtual meter; blocks period close above the threshold
flow.title: Energy Flow
flow.desc: Energy flow from inlet to end-use; band width = ledger total, gaps merge into unaccounted
flow.emptyLedger: No ledger data for the selected span. Build the ledger first (nightly pipeline or Reports screen).
meterTree.title: Metering Tree
meterTree.desc: submeterOf forms a same-medium DAG; roles drive aggregation, check meters are excluded
meterTree.noIssues: Structure is valid, no issues found
reports.title: Reports & Period Close
reports.desc: Closing a period is an audited human action — the gap-ratio gate is a hard limit, not a scheduled job
reports.gate.blocked: Gap ratio above threshold — close blocked
reports.gate.incomplete: Some meters have no ledger entries for this period; run the ledger build first
reports.gate.ok: Dry run passed, ready to close
safety.desc: Critical-load monitoring, medical IT insulation, power quality and electrical fire early warning — read-only, monitor-only; alarms reuse domain 11 (anomaly → work order), no L2 ledger
safety.empty.title: No electrical safety points at this site yet
safety.empty.hint: Wire volt/current/temp/insulation/THD/residual-current points in Data Model config; cards appear here automatically
safety.itHint: Medical IT isolation panels (group-2 locations); IR alarm threshold per IEC 60364-7-710 convention 50 Ω/V (~50 kΩ @ 220 V, final value subject to review), configurable per panel via emIrAlarmThreshold
safety.sag.title: Sag / over-limit anomaly events
safety.sag.hint: Events use the dual track (his trail + domain-11 anomaly); acknowledge / dispatch in Realtime & Alarms
safety.sag.subject: Subject
safety.fire.title: Circuit detail
safety.loop.title: Alarm loop (domain 11)
safety.loop.hint: No new alarm system: rule → anomaly → work order, same loop as Realtime & Alarms
kpi.title: Core KPI Assessment
kpi.desc: Energy & carbon intensity per area / person / bed — the data basis for green hospital accreditation; all values from ledger and site parameters, never computed on the frontend
kpi.paramsHint: Maintained in Data Model screen; missing denominators show as — below, never as 0
kpi.paramMissing: Not set — configure in Data Model
kpi.cardsHint: Current period values; core assessment indicators first
kpi.quotaHint: Same semantics as Quota & Benchmark; details and source labels live there
